title: orchestrate-terraform-helm-staged-upgrades-offline-signer-hook
author: Marisa Delgado
body:
Summary: Adds a staged upgrade orchestrator that coordinates Terraform plan execution and Helm release rollouts for private/on-prem installs, plus an offline signing hook for air-gapped release manifests.

Motivation: Customers running private deployments requested deterministic upgrade windows and a way to sign release manifests in environments without direct internet access. This PR implements a coordinated workflow:

1) compute and persist Terraform plan diffs and Helm chart OCI tags into a content-addressable release manifest;
2) emit an offline-signing payload that can be transferred to an approved signing station (cosign detached signatures supported);
3) implement a staged apply mode in the installer CLI that respects upgrade windows and can execute gated Helm rollouts with canary percentages and rollback plans.

Also adds a rollback-plan generator that pairs Helm revision history with the exact OCI artifests to guarantee deterministic rollback across air-gapped clusters.

What changed (high level):
- New package cmd/installer/staged-upgrade: orchestrator for staged upgrades and CLI flags --staged-apply, --staged-dry-run.
- Terraform module changes under modules/networking: plan serialization and stable plan IDs for cross-run matching.
- Helm chart/chartpress: annotate chart builds with content-addressable tags and include digest in the release manifest.
- CI buildkite/steps: add offline-signing job that writes a signing payload (tar.gz) to artifacts and a companion generate-signature.sh script for signing stations.
- manifests/release: new schema v2 for content-addressable release manifests and a migration helper.
- tests/e2e/offline-signing: integration tests that simulate a detached signing workflow in an air-gapped mode.

Commits (summary):
- 1a3f2b4: staged-upgrade orchestrator and installer flags
- 9bd2f11: terraform plan serializer + stable-plan-id util
- f7e8c3a: helm chart tagging + manifest v2 schema
- 2c4d99a: offline-signing job + signing helper scripts
- d12ef45: rollback-plan generator and matching logic
- 8b0a5c0: e2e tests for staged flow and offline signing
- 4f6b1aa: docs and CLI usage examples

Changed files (representative):
- cmd/installer/staged_upgrade.go
- modules/networking/plan_serializer.go
- charts/installer/Chart.yaml (annotation changes)
- charts/installer/templates/preflight-check.yaml
- manifests/release/v2-schema.md
- manifests/release/generate_manifest.go
- scripts/generate-signing-payload.sh
- ci/buildkite/offline-signing-step.yml
- tests/e2e/offline_signing_test.go
- docs/operator/staged-upgrades.md
- README.mkdocs (upgrade notes)

Testing and CI:
- Local unit tests for plan serializer and manifest generation added.
- Integration e2e test that runs a fake signing station to validate detached signatures.
- CI run: initial pipeline failed on e2e flake (helm template ordering mismatch) — test fixed by introducing deterministic release ordering in the manifest generator; pipeline rerun passed all checks (unit, lint, integration). Summary: all required checks green at merge time.

Review thread (high level):
- Omar: "Can the plan serializer be consumed by the operator to render a dry-run dashboard?" Reply: "Yes — added a small HTTP status endpoint in staged-upgrade to surface pending plans (docs updated)."
- Priya: "We need to ensure signer rotation doesn't invalidate previous manifests." Reply: "Added signer metadata (key id + rotation window) in the manifest and a compatibility check during apply; documented rotation semantics in manifests/release/v2-schema.md."
- Ben: "E2E flake was concerning — is the deterministic ordering robust across Go map iteration?" Reply: "Mapper now sorts keys explicitly before emitting manifest; test added to prevent regressions."
- QA: "Please add instructions for customers to use the signing helper in air-gapped workflows." Reply: "Included a README under scripts/ with step-by-step transfer and signing instructions; included sample systemd unit for signing stations."

Backward compatibility & migration:
- Added a small migrator that reads v1 manifests and emits v2 with best-effort mapping; v1 manifests will still be accepted in read-only compatibility mode with a warning.
- No breaking changes to existing installer runtime behavior unless customers opt into --staged-apply; therefore flagged breaking_change: false.

Security and compliance:
- Offline signing flow supports cosign detached signatures and optional hardware-backed signing (instructions for KMS/HSM export included).
- Manifest includes signer metadata and signature bundle location to improve provenance audits.

Merge: Squash-and-merge after approvals. Changelog: included short release notes and operator documentation.
release_notes: - Add staged-upgrades orchestrator and CLI flags (--staged-apply, --staged-dry-run); - Emit content-addressable release manifest v2 with stable Terraform plan IDs and Helm OCI digests; - Provide offline-signing payload and helper scripts for air-gapped signing stations; - Rollback-plan generator that ties Helm revision history to exact OCI artifacts; - Backwards compatible v1→v2 migrator and docs
notes: Targeted at private/on-prem customers; follow-on work tracked under ENG-2460 for U/X improvements to staged dashboard
